scripts.test:deploy: set -e; node scripts/verify-deployment-assets.mjs; for file in server/pocketbase/deploy/*.sh; do bash -n "$file"; done; bash server/pocketbase/deploy/preflight.sh --help >/dev/null
scripts.test:server: set -e; for file in server/pocketbase/pb_migrations/*.js server/pocketbase/pb_hooks/*.js; do node --check "$file"; done; npm run test:deploy
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:version && npm run test:sync && npm run test:server && npm run build
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:android && node scripts/run-gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run cap:android && node scripts/run-gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:android && node scripts/run-gradle.mjs assembleRelease bundleRelease
